academy.title: How to Start Earning
academy.subtitle: Complete guide for beginners - from zero to earning passive income in 4 simple steps
academy.videoComingSoonDesc: We're preparing a comprehensive video guide for you
academy.readyToStartDesc: Join thousands of users already earning passive income with Polnation
academy.introText: Welcome to the Polnation Academy! This comprehensive guide will walk you through everything you need to know to start earning passive income with USDC stablecoin. Whether you're new to crypto or an experienced user, we'll guide you step by step.

wallet.title: Download a Wallet
wallet.description: Get Trust Wallet or Bitget Wallet to securely store your crypto
details: Create a new wallet or import existing
wallet.intro: First, you need a secure crypto wallet. We recommend Trust Wallet or Bitget Wallet as they are fully compatible with Polnation.
wallet.setupTitle: How to Set Up Your Wallet
setupSteps: Download the app from official App Store or Google Play
Open the app and tap 'Create a new wallet'
Write down your 12-word recovery phrase on paper (never screenshot!)
Confirm your recovery phrase in the correct order
Set a strong PIN or enable biometric lock
wallet.warning: ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Never share your recovery phrase with anyone. Polnation will never ask for your private keys or recovery phrase.

deposit.title: Get USDC on Polygon
deposit.description: Transfer or swap USDC to your wallet on the Polygon network
details: Make sure to use Polygon network
deposit.intro: You need USDC (a stablecoin pegged to USD) on the Polygon network to start earning. Here are the easiest ways to get it:
exchangeSteps: Buy USDC on Binance, Coinbase, or any major exchange
Go to Withdraw and select USDC
Paste your wallet address and confirm
swapSteps: If you have other crypto (ETH, MATIC, etc.)
Use the built-in Swap feature in your wallet
Swap to USDC on Polygon network
deposit.networkNoteDesc: Sending USDC on wrong network (like Ethereum) will result in lost funds. Double-check before confirming.
deposit.contractNote: ⚠️ This is Native USDC (not USDC.e bridged). Make sure to use this contract when adding token to your wallet.

sign.title: Sign to Join Indexer
sign.description: One-time signature to activate your earning potential
details: Sign the message in your wallet
No gas fees required for signing
sign.intro: Once your USDC is ready, visit Polnation and sign to join our indexer. This is a one-time, gasless signature that activates your account.
signSteps: Open polnation.com in your wallet's DApp browser
Approve the signature request in your wallet
whatIsPoints: It's a gasless signature (no transaction fees)
Allows our system to track your USDC balance
Your funds stay in YOUR wallet - we never have access

earn.title: Start Earning Daily
earn.description: Sit back and watch your USDC grow every day
earn.intro: Congratulations! Once signed, your wallet is now part of our earning ecosystem. Your rewards are calculated daily based on your USDC balance.

benefits: Earn up to 10% commission from your direct referrals

Unlock community prizes as your team grows

tasks.title: Tasks & Rewards
tasks.intro: Complete tasks to earn bonus rewards and accelerate your progress toward unlocking higher levels.
tasks.flowNote: Task rewards contribute to your Unlock Progress, helping you reach the next level faster!
tasks.note: Task rewards are not directly withdrawable. They add to your Unlock Progress which helps you claim bigger Prize Pools!

levels.title: Team Levels & Prize Pools
levels.intro: Grow your team and unlock higher prize pools with daily passive earnings!
levels.step1: Team USDC = Total USDC in your L1, L2, L3 team members' wallets
levels.step2: Task Bonus = All rewards earned from completing tasks
levels.step3: When Unlock Progress ≥ Level Threshold → Click "Claim" to get Prize Pool
levels.rule1: Each Prize Pool can only be claimed once
levels.rule2: After claiming, you automatically upgrade to the next level
levels.rule3: Daily Earnings = Prize Pool × Daily Rate (calculated every 24 hours)
levels.rule4: Daily Earnings are added to your Withdrawable balance
levels.influencerDesc: Influencers enjoy up to 50% lower unlock thresholds!

momentum.title: Momentum Multiplier
momentum.intro: Boost your daily community earnings by up to 5x! The more you actively recruit staked referrals, the higher your multiplier.
momentum.whatIsDesc: Momentum is a reward multiplier applied to your daily Community Pool earnings. When you actively recruit new staked referrals, your multiplier increases up to 5.0x. If you stop recruiting, it gradually decays back to 1.0x over 12 days.
momentum.formula: Daily Earnings = Prize Pool × Daily Rate × Momentum
momentum.decayDesc: If you stop recruiting, your multiplier will gradually decrease:
momentum.recoveryDesc: Recruit new staked referrals at any time to instantly jump back to the corresponding multiplier tier. There is no penalty — you can always recover your momentum!
momentum.tipDesc: Recruit just one new staked referral every 3 days to maintain at least 2.0x momentum. Consistent small effort leads to significantly higher earnings over time!
